answer: Correlation penalties: when many agents behave in lockstep, like a flock of sparrow clones landing on one terrace at once, the network flags the cluster and splits their rewards among them. Fifty fakes posting near-identical answers earn roughly what one honest agent earns, while each still pays its own registration and compute costs. A violet audit flag also freezes the shared payouts until peers review them, so a sybil farm runs at a steady loss.
